title: B40 figured out ! (revised)
text:
B40 figured out ! (revised). [[VIDEOID:mo19EHGJ5CIJIV4]]I have a Keurig B40 Elite Brewing System, and also an EZ-Cup for Keurig Coffee Machines By Perfect Pod.
After reading all these reviews I finally decided to give this a try (I had been using the paper filters that come with my EZ-Cup)

First off, I think I know now a lot of people's frustration, as this item WILL NOT fit into my B40 with the EZ-Cup holder.
(these filters are for the My K-Cup instead)
It's too large to fit when combined with the EZ-Cup? Maybe other models are different.
If I use this filter alone (with just the cap from the EZ-Cup holder), I have to forcefully close the B40 and end up with a hole in the plastic of the filter rendering it useless going forward. (This was my bad .. read below)

*** REVISED 3/13 *** I attached a VIDEO *** (hope this helps)
After playing around with the B40 .. I finally figured out how to get this to work!
You must remove the bottom needle assembly before use. The instructions kinda say this , but do not specifically state "REMOVE THE BOTTOM NEEDLE" before use.
Once you remove this assembly there IS ROOM to now use. You should never use any of these home fill your own filters with the bottom needle still in the coffee-maker! (remove it) I feel stupid not realizing this .. but honestly the instructions were awful to point this out in BOLD letters.

The secret to making these work .. REMOVE THE BOTTOM NEEDLE (it's assembly pops out)

Hope this helps someone else .. and yes, I feel like an idiot for not figuring this out before.

Using the larger basket makes a decently strong cup of coffee. I have to ding the product for failing to make instructions. Also using the product is about as time consuming as brewing a full-pot thru drip (setup and clean up)
